headline: De Narvaez's GDN Acquires Dia's Argentine Supermarkets for $55 Million
summary: GDN, the parent company of supermarket chain ChangoMas, acquired the Argentine operations of Spanish retailer Dia in a deal valued at approximately $55 million.
why: The transaction accelerates consolidation in South America's retail sector as European operators shed assets amid local macroeconomic volatility.

impacts.name: Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentacion, S.A.
impacts.why: Sale of its Argentine unit generates roughly $55 million in proceeds and eliminates Latin American market exposure.
